assumptions.statement: The repository provisional rough boundary and three key-area rectangles are used only for concept topology and display.
assumptions.impact: Every area-sensitive layer and metric has low confidence and cannot support redline, parcel or approval claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official site and key-area polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, height, density, setback, road-redline and facility controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Statutory intensity metrics remain unknown; colour blocks are concept programmes only.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory planning conditions are supplied.

assumptions.statement: No complete existing-building, condition, ownership or heritage survey is available.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are conceptual interface prototypes; no specific demolition decision is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Measured survey, title, structure, fire and heritage assessments are complete.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, traffic counts, station interfaces and bus operations are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Roads express walking, cycling and station connection needs rather than engineering alignments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Transport survey and authority coordination are complete.

assumptions.statement: Utility capacity, drainage, energy load, fire access and underground conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Canopies, charging, compute and rainwater systems remain component concepts.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Utility and engineering due diligence is complete.

assumptions.statement: Heritage inventory, important views, old trees, green lines, blue lines and river-management controls are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: The public-space kit must be repositioned or reduced if specialist controls conflict.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Heritage, arboricultural and ecological surveys are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Events, alliances, budgets, recruitment, grants and procurement pathways are design recommendations only.
assumptions.impact: No government, company, funder or community commitment is claimed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Named parties adopt a governance charter and resource plan.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios require purpose limitation, minimum data, human review, an exit and an independent retrospective.
assumptions.impact: High-risk or immature uses may be stopped and must retain non-digital service alternatives.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Each operator completes privacy, safety, accessibility and legal review.
